name: NOVA
desc: Unified inference layer that orchestrates LLMs, vision models and custom adapters. Request routing, intelligent fallbacks, cost-aware model selection and full observability. Built for production, not demos.
problem: Teams juggling 5+ model providers with brittle prompt logic and no fallback. One failure = product failure.
build: FastAPI gateway with Redis queues, Postgres telemetry, token-weighted routing algorithm. Every request logged, scored, and replayable.

name: Atlas
desc: RAG-native second brain for teams. Ingests docs, transcriptions, links and APIs into a queryable graph. Not another chatbot wrapper — actual source-grounded recall with citations.
problem: Knowledge trapped in Notion, Drive, Slack. Search returns links, not answers.
build: React front, Qdrant vector store, hybrid search (BM25 + vectors), graph traversal for context expansion. Every answer includes path to source.

name: CRM Ticketing System
desc: End-to-end ticketing and CRM for a real service business. Role-based access, SLA automation, revenue tracking, analytics. Built under real constraints with real users complaining.
problem: Founders using spreadsheets and WhatsApp to manage £10k/mo revenue pipeline. Chaos.
build: Multi-tenant Postgres, Row Level Security, event-driven automation, real-time dashboards. Deployed and handling 400+ tickets/month.

name: Calisthenics App
desc: Progressive calisthenics training focused on skill acquisition, not random workouts. Program logic that adapts based on prerequisite strength, form cues, and actual progression.
problem: Existing apps: generic push-up counters or influencer PDFs. No system to get to muscle-up.
build: Expo + Supabase realtime. Custom progression engine that unlocks skills only when strength standards verified. Video cues, tempo tracking.
